origin: Talk-Masters began in 2014 as an independent speaking club, and joined Toastmasters International after 150 sessions.

numbers.label: friends called on the drive home

milestones.title: The minute that started it
milestones.text: A short Independence Day speech in Deira, and a decision on the drive home to Sharjah.

milestones.title: The first gathering
milestones.text: Twelve people at a hotel in Sharjah, opened by Adv. KSA Basheer. Everyone came forward and spoke.

milestones.title: 150 independent sessions
milestones.text: Structured agendas, guest speakers and mentors, rooms of six and rooms of more than 100.

milestones.title: Joining Toastmasters International
milestones.text: Chartered as club 07956953 in District 127, Division C, Area 11, bringing seven years of community into a wider international family.

milestones.title: Recognised
milestones.text: The Smedley Award (Bronze) for the club, and Triple Crown Awards for Ganesan Venkatachalam, DTM, and Mohammed Jabir.

milestones.title: Every 2nd and 4th Sunday
milestones.text: Members of every age and background, meeting at Hor Al Anz Public Library, Dubai. Guests are always welcome.

legacy: Every long journey begins with a single step. Ours began on 5 September 2014, and the journey continues.
